Pre-1900 Banks

EasyFreeQuerying BasicsDate Functions

Find banks established before 1900 — the legacy institutions. The established_date column is text in MM/DD/YYYY format. Extract the year and filter. Show name, state, established_date. Order by year ascending (oldest first), then by name alphabetically for ties.

Solve it in the browser editor →

Runs on SQLite in your browser, graded against the expected result, no signup. A wrong answer gets a diagnosis, not just "incorrect".

Expected output: Pre-1900 chartered US banks

Hint

SQLite: extract the year with SUBSTR(established_date, 7, 4) and CAST it to integer, then filter < 1900. Order by that year ascending, then name ascending — the grader checks order exactly.
